g.text: Select only ONE mux channel at a time. Never select 0x03 with identical slaves.

g.desc: Select only ONE mux channel at a time. Never select 0x03 with identical slaves.

g.text: DRV REG capacitor = 1uF; IN/TRIG = GND; EN pulled high; use I2C standby/GO.

g.desc: DRV REG capacitor = 1uF; IN/TRIG = GND; EN pulled high; use I2C standby/GO.

g.text: HAPTIC_VDD defaults to 3V3, not unregulated USB 5V. Motor rated/overdrive settings NOT verified.

g.desc: HAPTIC_VDD defaults to 3V3, not unregulated USB 5V. Motor rated/overdrive settings NOT verified.

g.text: Motor OUT+/OUT- float: neither is GND. On motor six test pads, outermost two only; insulate middle four.

g.desc: Motor OUT+/OUT- float: neither is GND. On motor six test pads, outermost two only; insulate middle four.

g.text: MCU + reset / BOOT / debug: existing firmware GPIO map

g.desc: MCU + reset / BOOT / debug: existing firmware GPIO map

g.text: 3V3 CONTROL RAIL: AP63203 fixed-output reference topology

g.desc: 3V3 CONTROL RAIL: AP63203 fixed-output reference topology

g.text: MCU USB FULL-SPEED / future Hub downstream P6

g.desc: MCU USB FULL-SPEED / future Hub downstream P6

g.text: JU1 pin1 NC: no VBUS back-feed. Supply Core through JPOWER1.

g.desc: JU1 pin1 NC: no VBUS back-feed. Supply Core through JPOWER1.

g.text: This is an internal USB2 branch, not a USB-C receptacle / USB3 port.

g.desc: This is an internal USB2 branch, not a USB-C receptacle / USB3 port.

g.text: External test adapter must provide connector-side ESD protection.

g.desc: External test adapter must provide connector-side ESD protection.

g.text: Keep D+/D- paired and short; final high-speed layout is a separate gate.

g.desc: Keep D+/D- paired and short; final high-speed layout is a separate gate.

g.text: HAPTICS: mux 0x70; channel0 LEFT / channel1 RIGHT; each driver 0x5A

g.desc: HAPTICS: mux 0x70; channel0 LEFT / channel1 RIGHT; each driver 0x5A

g.text: Future independent screen press is not connected.

g.desc: Future independent screen press is not connected.

g.text: historical physical wire labels need assembly check.

g.desc: historical physical wire labels need assembly check.

g.text: OPTIONAL AUDIO / MICROPHONE: keep modules external

g.desc: OPTIONAL AUDIO / MICROPHONE: keep modules external

g.text: Harness pin numbers are new PCB pad numbers, not the LCD FPC order.

g.desc: Harness pin numbers are new PCB pad numbers, not the LCD FPC order.

g.text: Preserve actual module silk CS/SCK/D0..D3 and SDA/SCL/3V3/GND.

g.desc: Preserve actual module silk CS/SCK/D0..D3 and SDA/SCL/3V3/GND.

g.text: One upstream I2C pull-up set only. QSPI return uses adjacent power harness.

g.desc: One upstream I2C pull-up set only. QSPI return uses adjacent power harness.

g.text: WROOM-1 electrical pinout = WROOM-1U; explicit 1U footprint.

g.desc: WROOM-1 electrical pinout = WROOM-1U; explicit 1U footprint.

g.text: N16R8: GPIO35/36/37 reserved by Octal PSRAM.

g.desc: N16R8: GPIO35/36/37 reserved by Octal PSRAM.

g.text: Unused GPIOs are NC; antenna cable and antenna remain external.

g.desc: Unused GPIOs are NC; antenna cable and antenna remain external.

g.text: CORE CONTROL REVA - ELECTRICAL STUDY, NOT RELEASED FOR FAB

g.desc: CORE CONTROL REVA - ELECTRICAL STUDY, NOT RELEASED FOR FAB

g.text: JA1 is the already-tested I2S amplifier interface, not the motor driver.

g.desc: JA1 is the already-tested I2S amplifier interface, not the motor driver.

g.text: MAX outputs drive only the speaker differential pair; never ground OUT-.

g.desc: MAX outputs drive only the speaker differential pair; never ground OUT-.

g.text: JM1 pin6 straps INMP441 L/R low for LEFT; module itself provides decoupling.

g.desc: JM1 pin6 straps INMP441 L/R low for LEFT; module itself provides decoupling.

g.text: Microphone code optional, hardware not verified; default DNP.

g.desc: Microphone code optional, hardware not verified; default DNP.

g.text: Not included: USB7206C Hub, PC/Dock power mux/PD, A1/A2/FAST-C, magnetic face, Dock high-speed connector.

g.desc: Not included: USB7206C Hub, PC/Dock power mux/PD, A1/A2/FAST-C, magnetic face, Dock high-speed connector.

g.text: These need exact receptacle/connector pin maps, source budgets and impedance/stackup design.

g.desc: These need exact receptacle/connector pin maps, source budgets and impedance/stackup design.

g.text: Screen assembly and EC11 use brackets/cables; motors attach to shell, not PCB pads.

g.desc: Screen assembly and EC11 use brackets/cables; motors attach to shell, not PCB pads.

g.text: Do not synchronize this new control sheet into the old CN7/CN10 schematic or overwrite the main placement PCB.

g.desc: Do not synchronize this new control sheet into the old CN7/CN10 schematic or overwrite the main placement PCB.

g.text: Not raw USB-C / PD. 2A converter rating is not a USB power budget.

g.desc: Not raw USB-C / PD. 2A converter rating is not a USB power budget.

g.text: Do not parallel this 3V3 output with future Hub regulator.

g.desc: Do not parallel this 3V3 output with future Hub regulator.

g.text: JPOWER1 and L1 exact physical parts remain selection gates.

g.desc: JPOWER1 and L1 exact physical parts remain selection gates.

g.text: INPUTS: four keys + EC11, active-low to GND

g.desc: INPUTS: four keys + EC11, active-low to GND
